title: ML-guided mechanosynthesis yields a lead-free photocatalyst
summary: Machine-learning-guided synthesis and testing identified a lead-free metal-halide perovskite for oxidative alkene cleavage. The publisher reports an 80% benzoic-acid yield under the study’s conditions, compared with 6% for the initial Cs2AgBiBr6 benchmark. This is a formulation- and reaction-specific laboratory result, not universal photocatalytic performance or industrial deployment.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-assisted materials selection and iterative synthesis

evidence.tested: Publisher article reports an experimentally tested ML-selected perovskite yielding 80% benzoic acid versus 6% for the initial benchmark in the specified reaction.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broader application are not established by this bounded review.
evidence.ai_role: ML ranks perovskite candidates using experimental feedback across synthesis rounds; researchers synthesize and test the selected photocatalysts.

source_review.scope: Publisher indexed primary full text and metadata; specific formulation and selected result reviewed. Earlier disclosure not established in this pass.
